newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SOCCER-HUNGARY, NORWAY DRAW 1-1 IN WORLD CUP QUALFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HUNGARY, NORWAY DRAW 1-1 IN WORLD CUP QUALFIER.

text.p: Hungary and Norway drew 1-1 (halftime 1-1) in their World Cup European zone group three qualifier on Sunday.

Hungary: 20-Gabor Babos, 2-Attila Kuttor, 3-Janos Banfi, 4-Norbert Nagy (12-Zoltan Szlezak 60), 5-Emil Lorincz, 6-Gabor Halmai, 7-Tibor Dombi, 8-Laszlo Farkashazy, 9-Ferenc Orosz (13-Attila Dragoner 86), 10-Tamas Sandor (15-Elek Nyilas 80), 11-Zoltan Kovacs.

Norway: 1-Frode Grodaas, 2-Alf-Inge Haland, 3-Ronny Johnsen, 4-Henning Berg, 5-Stig Inge Bjorneby, 6-Frank Strandli,7-Erik Mykland (16-Jostein Flo 67), 8-Oyvind Leonhardsen (17-Sale Solbakken 76), 9-Tore A. Flo (18-Egil Ostenstad 81). 10-Kjetil Rekdal, 11-Petter Rudi
